context: A boss reviews a publication project
purpose: Teach: 校正/無条件/専属/協賛/巻頭/研修生/組み込む/見越し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 原稿の校正、丁寧に進めろ。
lines.en: Proofread the manuscript carefully and methodically.
lines.style: Clipped, direct instruction. Crisp attack on the opening word. Authoritative but not harsh—the tone of someone used to being listened to. Even pace, no breath wasted.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。広告主、無条件に契約継続を希望しています。
lines.en: Yes. The advertisers want to renew their contracts unconditionally.
lines.style: Clear, factual delivery. Slight formal stiffness—this is a report upward. Steady pace, no embellishment. A small nod of completion in the voice.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 専属の編集者、引き継ぎ、しっかり。
lines.en: The in-house editor handover needs to be solid. Make it happen.
lines.style: Directive and measured. Light emphasis on 'solid' — this matters. Direct eye contact in the voice. No room for wavering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。協賛企業、リスト、整理しました。
lines.en: Yes. The sponsor list is organized and ready.
lines.style: Efficient confirmation. Matter-of-fact, slightly faster than the previous line—checking off a box. Competent, unadorned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 巻頭ページ、目玉企画にしろ。
lines.en: Make the lead page the centerpiece. Full impact.
lines.style: Sharp instruction with conviction. Hard attack on the first word. Deliberate, measured—giving weight to what matters. Not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。研修生も執筆に組み込むことに、しました。
lines.en: Yes. The trainees are now included in the writing assignments.
lines.style: Steady reporting. Slight warmth underneath—acknowledging a decision made. Professional pace, not defensive. Simple statement of fact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 読者数の伸び、見越して、増刷。
lines.en: Anticipate the readership growth. Approve the reprint run.
lines.style: Strategic and assured. Forward-looking tone—seeing ahead. Steady delivery, authoritative without strain. This is how decisions are made.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Quiet acknowledgment. Single syllable weight. The voice of someone confirming receipt of final orders. Brief, respectful, done.
